33148.a:
| Flag | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `-c` | create — arxiv yaratish |
| `-x` | extract — ochish |
| `-t` | list — ichini ko'rish |
| `-r` | append — mavjud (siqilmagan) arxivga qo'shish |
| `-u` | update — faqat yangiroq fayllarni qo'shish |
| `-f FILE` | arxiv fayli (`-` = stdin/stdout). **f doim oxirida**: `czf` to'g'ri, `cfz` -> "z" nomli fayl! |
| `-v` | har faylni chiqarish (`-vv` ruxsatlar bilan) |
| `-z` / `-j` / `-J` / `--zstd` | gzip / bzip2 / xz / zstd |
| `-a` | kengaytmaga qarab siqishni o'zi tanlaydi (`tar caf x.tar.xz dir`) |
| `-C DIR` | shu katalogga o'tib ishlash |
| `-p` | ruxsatlarni saqlash (root uchun default) |
| `--same-owner` / `--numeric-owner` | egalarni saqlash / UID raqam bilan |
| `--exclude=PATTERN`, `-X file` | chiqarib tashlash |
| `--strip-components=N` | ochishda N ta yuqori katalogni tashlab yuborish |
| `-h` | symlink o'rniga u ko'rsatgan faylni olish |
| `-P` | absolut yo'llarni saqlash (`/` ni olib tashlamaslik — xavfli) |
| `-k` / `--skip-old-files` | mavjud fayllarni ustidan yozmaslik |
| `-W` / `--verify` | yozgandan keyin tekshirish |
| `--acls --xattrs --selinux` | kengaytirilgan atributlar |
| `-g snapshot.file` | incremental backup |

```
tar -czvf app-$(date +%F).tar.gz -C /opt app --exclude='app/logs/*' --exclude='*.tmp'
tar -tzvf app.tar.gz | less                  # ochmasdan ko'rish
tar -xzf app.tar.gz -C /srv                  # /srv ichiga
tar -xzf node.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C /usr/local/node
tar -xzf app.tar.gz app/config.yaml          # bitta fayl
tar -cf - /data | pigz -p 8 > data.tar.gz    # parallel siqish
tar -cpf - dir | ssh host "tar -xpf - -C /dst"   # diskka yozmasdan ko'chirish
tar -czf - dir | split -b 1G - part.tar.gz.  ; cat part.tar.gz.* | tar -xzf -
tar -cg /var/bkp/snap -zf full.tgz /etc ; tar -cg /var/bkp/snap -zf inc1.tgz /etc   # incremental
```
Tuzoq: tar o'zi **siqmaydi** — faqat bitta faylga yig'adi; siqish z/J/zstd bilan. Ochishdan oldin `-t` bilan ko'r (tarbomb — joriy katalogga yuzlab fayl tushishi).

33149.a:
| Flag | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `gzip file` | `file.gz` yaratadi, **`file` o'chadi** |
| `-k` | keep — aslini saqlash |
| `-d` | decompress (= `gunzip`) |
| `-c` | stdout'ga yozish (asl fayl tegmaydi) |
| `-1` ... `-9` | tez/kam siqish ... sekin/ko'p siqish (default 6); `--fast`=-1, `--best`=-9 |
| `-r` | katalogdagi har faylni alohida siqish (arxiv emas!) |
| `-l` | siqilgan/asl hajm, nisbat |
| `-t` | butunlikni tekshirish |
| `-v` | verbose (siqish %) |
| `-f` | majburlash (mavjud .gz ustidan) |
| `-n` / `-N` | asl nom/vaqtni saqlamaslik/saqlash |

```
gzip -k -9 dump.sql                 # dump.sql.gz, dump.sql qoladi
gunzip dump.sql.gz                  # = gzip -d
gzip -dc dump.sql.gz | psql mydb    # diskka ochmasdan import
mysqldump db | gzip > db.sql.gz     # oqimni siqish
gzip -l app.log.gz ; gzip -t app.log.gz && echo OK
zcat app.log.1.gz | tail ; zless app.log.2.gz
zgrep -i "error" /var/log/nginx/access.log.*.gz
zdiff a.gz b.gz
pigz -p 8 -k big.log                # parallel gzip (ko'p core)
unpigz big.log.gz
```
- gzip **bitta faylni** siqadi; ko'p fayl/katalog uchun `tar -czf`.
- `.tgz` = `.tar.gz`.
- Allaqachon siqilgan ma'lumotni (jpg, mp4, zip) siqish deyarli foyda bermaydi.

33150.a:
**zip**
| Flag | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `zip out.zip a b` | fayllarni qo'shish |
| `-r` | katalogni rekursiv (**busiz faqat bo'sh katalog qo'shiladi**) |
| `-x 'pattern'` | chiqarib tashlash |
| `-u` / `-f` | update (yangi+o'zgargan) / freshen (faqat mavjudlarni) |
| `-d` | arxivdan faylni o'chirish |
| `-0` ... `-9` | siqish darajasi (0 = faqat saqlash) |
| `-e` | parol (ZipCrypto — zaif; `7z -p -mhe=on` yoki gpg yaxshiroq) |
| `-q` / `-v` | jim / batafsil |
| `-j` | yo'llarsiz (faqat fayl nomlari) |
| `-y` | symlink'ni symlink sifatida saqlash |
| `-s 1g` | bo'laklarga bo'lish (split) |
| `-T` | yaratgandan keyin tekshirish |

**unzip**
| Flag | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `-l` | ichini ko'rish |
| `-d DIR` | shu katalogga ochish |
| `-o` / `-n` | so'ramay ustidan yozish / hech qachon yozmaslik |
| `-t` | test |
| `-q` | jim |
| `-j` | katalog tuzilmasisiz |
| `-p` | stdout'ga (pipe) |
| `-x` | ochishda chiqarib tashlash |

```
zip -r -9 site.zip public/ -x "*.map" "public/tmp/*"
unzip -l site.zip
unzip -q site.zip -d /var/www/site
unzip -o release.zip 'config/*' -d /opt/app
unzip -p data.zip report.csv | head
zipinfo site.zip
```
| | zip | tar.gz |
|---|---|---|
| Siqish | har fayl alohida | butun oqim birga (yaxshiroq nisbat) |
| Bitta faylni olish | tez (random access) | butun oqimni ochish kerak |
| Unix ruxsat/owner | qisman | to'liq |
| Moslik | Windows/hamma joyda | Unix |
Linux backup/deploy uchun tar (+ zstd/gzip), foydalanuvchiga yoki Windows'ga berish uchun zip. Ishonchsiz zip ochishda path traversal (`../`, "zip slip") xavfi — avval `unzip -l`.

33151.a:
```
# xz
xz -k -T0 -9 big.tar          # big.tar.xz, barcha core'lar
xz -d big.tar.xz ; unxz ; xzcat ; xz -l big.tar.xz
# bzip2
bzip2 -k file ; bunzip2 file.bz2 ; bzcat ; pbzip2 (parallel)
# zstd
zstd -T0 -3 big.sql           # tez (default 3)
zstd -T0 -19 --long=27 big.sql   # yaxshi siqish, katta oyna
zstd -d big.sql.zst ; unzstd ; zstdcat ; zstd -t
tar -I 'zstd -T0 -10' -cf data.tar.zst /data      # tar + istalgan siqgich
# 7z
7z a -mx=9 out.7z dir/ ; 7z x out.7z -o/dst ; 7z l out.7z
```
Taqqoslash (taxminiy, log/SQL kabi matn uchun):
| | Siqish nisbati | Siqish tezligi | Ochish tezligi |
|---|---|---|---|
| gzip -6 | o'rta | o'rta | tez |
| zstd -3 | gzip'dan yaxshi | ancha tez | juda tez |
| zstd -19 | xz'ga yaqin | sekin | juda tez |
| xz -9 | eng yaxshi | juda sekin, RAM ko'p | o'rta |
| bzip2 | yaxshi | sekin | sekin |

Katta fayllar bilan ishlash:
```
split -b 2G -d big.tar.zst part_          # part_00, part_01...
cat part_* > big.tar.zst
sha256sum big.tar.zst > big.sha256 ; sha256sum -c big.sha256
pv big.sql | zstd -T0 > big.sql.zst       # progress
nice -n 19 ionice -c3 tar ...             # prod serverni bo'g'ib qo'ymaslik
```
Tanlov: backup/log arxiv — zstd; release tarball — xz; universal moslik (eski tizim, HTTP) — gzip.
